summary: Rabbi Soffer goes through Psukim in Parashat Lech Lecha in Beresheet with Rashi and Midrash explanations. He discusses why Lot was taken captive, who the refugee was that informed Abraham, and how Abraham pursued the four kings to Dan. He also covers the meeting with the king of Sdom and Malki Tzedek bringing bread and wine.
